paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 5.88, which represents a decrease of 4.85% from the prior close and 6.81% over the last 21 sessions. There have been 7 new news articles in the last 24 hours. Recent news headlines include articles from Moomoo, Seeking Alpha, Investing.com, and NewsChannel 10 on MSN, discussing Fermi's securing of its first AI data center lease in a $6.5 billion deal.

The recent news is driven by Fermi's announcement of a binding customer lease at its Project Matador campus in Carson County, with the agreement projected to generate about $6.5 billion in contracted revenue over the initial term. The lease is with TensorWave, and delivery of the first phase is set to begin in the second half of 2027.

There have been various SEC filings from Fermi Inc., including the appointment of new officers, the resignation of director Miles Everson, and the issuance of $431.25 million in aggregate principal amount of 5.00% convertible senior notes due 2031. There has been one Form 4 filing and no Form 144 filings. Additionally, there have been 2 new social posts in the last 24 hours, with samples including discussions of the binding lease agreement with TensorWave and the stock's after-hours gains.
